name: Midify
original_description: Turn your musical ideas into polished songs with Midify. Whether you have a melody in your head or just a vibe, Midify acts as your AI co-pilot to compose, edit, and enhance your music. Simply ask Midify to generate a chord progression, fix a harmony, or expand a simple loop into a full arrangement. It analyzes your track and provides intelligent suggestions, allowing you to build complex MIDI compositions directly in the chat. No music theory required.
summary_ja: コード進行やハーモニーを検討し、会話でMIDIの楽曲構成を作る。
